Config.PerformanceImpact.Name: Performance Impact
Config.PerformanceImpact.Tooltip: Measures how close you are to no longer being able to reach 60 FPS.
Config.Preview.Name: Preview
Config.Preview.Tooltip: If enabled, snowflakes will be shown in this config menu.
Config.SnowDensity.Name: Snow Density
Config.SnowDensity.Tooltip: The approximate percentage of the screen covered by snow during snowy weather. Higher density incurs a higher performance cost.
Config.SnowDensityVariance.Name: Snow Density Variance
Config.SnowDensityVariance.Tooltip: How much the snow density can randomly increase or decrease from your chosen snow density setting on any given day.
Config.SnowflakeScale.Name: Snowflake Scale
Config.SnowflakeScale.Tooltip: A multiplier for the size of snowflakes. Higher values will make snowflakes larger.
Config.SnowflakeScaleVariance.Name: Snowflake Scale Variance
Config.SnowflakeScaleVariance.Tooltip: How much the scale of snowflakes can randomly increase or decrease from your chosen scale setting on any given day.
Config.WindSpeed.Name: Wind Speed
Config.WindSpeed.Tooltip: A multiplier for the speed of the implied wind. Higher values will make the snowflakes move faster.
Config.WindSpeedVariance.Name: Wind Speed Variance
Config.WindSpeedVariance.Tooltip: How much the wind speed can randomly increase or decrease from your chosen wind speed setting on any given day.
Config.RotationSpeed.Name: Rotation Speed
Config.RotationSpeed.Tooltip: A multiplier for the speed of a snowflake's rotation. Higher values will make snowflakes rotate faster.
Config.SnowflakeMovement.Name: Snowflake Movement
Config.SnowflakeMovement.Tooltip: Determines how the snowflakes move across the screen. Listed in order of increasing performance cost.
Config.HighFramerate.Name: High Framerate
Config.HighFramerate.Tooltip: If enabled, snowflakes will be updated at a higher framerate. This may or may not improve the visual smoothness to you, but it will incur a higher performance cost.
Config.PixelatedSnowflakes.Name: Pixelated Snowflakes
Config.PixelatedSnowflakes.Tooltip: If enabled, snowflakes will be drawn pixelated like the rest of the game. If disabled, they will be drawn with a smoother (and blurrier) non-pixelated look.
Config.ColourSettings.Name: Colour Settings
Config.ColourSettings.Tooltip: Configure the colours of the snowflakes and fog.
Config.SnowflakeRed.Name: Snowflake Red
Config.SnowflakeRed.Tooltip: The red component of the snowflake colour.
Config.SnowflakeGreen.Name: Snowflake Green
Config.SnowflakeGreen.Tooltip: The green component of the snowflake colour.
Config.SnowflakeBlue.Name: Snowflake Blue
Config.SnowflakeBlue.Tooltip: The blue component of the snowflake colour.
Config.SnowflakeAlpha.Name: Snowflake Alpha
Config.SnowflakeAlpha.Tooltip: The alpha (transparency) component of the snowflake colour.
Config.SnowflakeColourVariance.Name: Snowflake Colour Variance
Config.SnowflakeColourVariance.Tooltip: How much two snowflakes can randomly differ from each other in colour.
Config.FogRed.Name: Fog Red
Config.FogRed.Tooltip: The red component of the fog colour.
Config.FogGreen.Name: Fog Green
Config.FogGreen.Tooltip: The green component of the fog colour.
Config.FogBlue.Name: Fog Blue
Config.FogBlue.Tooltip: The blue component of the fog colour.
Config.FogAlpha.Name: Fog Alpha
Config.FogAlpha.Tooltip: The alpha (transparency) component of the fog colour.
